body: Current lino-arguments 0.3.0 declares links-notation ^0.11.2 and lino-env ^0.2.6. A consumer with latest root links-notation 0.25.2 therefore retains a nested 0.11.2 grammar. Please assess compatibility and refresh the maintained dependency range with parser/CLI/environment interoperability tests, or document a deliberate compatibility limit. This is a latest-dependency/deduplication maintenance request, not a reproduced application failure. The consumer will not force a potentially incompatible pre-1.0 minor through an override. Current app finite suites and room/bed pricing controls pass. Evidence: https://github.com/konard/vietnam-accomodation-search/commit/20ac35d50129157769c2460d88ffe564ceab7d73 . Browser Commander has a similar independently reported range gap in link-foundation/browser-commander#168; lino-env also declares the old grammar and needs a coordinated migration. No credentials or source materials are included.
title: Refresh maintained Links Notation dependency and support a deduplicated latest grammar graph

Found while upgrading [hh-job-application-automation](https://github.com/konard/hh-job-application-automation) to lino-arguments 0.3.0 (commit konard/hh-job-application-automation@54b771f):

- [ ] **Outdated pinned dependencies.** lino-arguments depends on `yargs ^17.7.2` and `links-notation ^0.11.2`, while the latest are yargs 18.2.0 and links-notation 0.23.0. Consumers end up with duplicate copies of both.
- [ ] **Env-var defaults are boilerplate for every option.** Every option repeats its own name as an environment variable:
  ```js
  .option('job-application-interval', { type: 'number', default: getenv('JOB_APPLICATION_INTERVAL', 20) })
  .option('verbose', { type: 'boolean', default: getenv('VERBOSE', false) })
  ```
  An opt-in mapping would remove this, typed by the option's `type`. It could be `makeConfig({ env: { autoMap: true } })` or a per-option `env: 'START_URL'` for renamed variables. yargs' own `.env('')` is not usable here because it maps every process variable.
title: Update pinned yargs/links-notation and auto-map options to env vars

body:
## Problem

The npm release after PR #38 failed, so npm still serves `lino-arguments@0.3.0` (published 2026-04-10). The dependency updates merged in #38 never reached npm:

- links-notation ^0.23.0
- yargs ^18
- `@dotenvx/dotenvx` ^2

Downstream lockfiles therefore still resolve links-notation 0.11.x and yargs 17 through lino-arguments.

Failing run: https://github.com/link-foundation/lino-arguments/actions/runs/37564452408 (JavaScript CI/CD, `Release` job, 2026-10-07):

```text
node ../scripts/version-and-commit.mjs --mode changeset --tag-prefix "js_" --release-label "JavaScript"
Error: Could not find Cargo.toml in expected locations.
Searched in:
  - ./Cargo.toml (single-language repository)
  - ./rust/Cargo.toml (multi-language repository)
    at getRustRoot (scripts/rust-paths.mjs:82:9)
    at scripts/version-and-commit.mjs:56:18
```

The step runs with the workflow default `working-directory: js` (`.github/workflows/js.yml:47-49`; line 320 calls `../scripts/version-and-commit.mjs`), so the relative lookups `./Cargo.toml` and `./rust/Cargo.toml` can't find the workspace. The JavaScript release path also shouldn't need the Rust root at all.

## Workaround used downstream

https://github.com/link-foundation/lino-i18n/pull/27 keeps `lino-arguments` at ^0.3.0, the latest version on npm, and records the stale transitive versions as blocked by this release.

## Suggested fix

Any one of these:

- Resolve the Rust root from the repository root instead of the current directory, for example `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`, or `path.resolve(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url), '../..')` from `scripts/`.
- Pass `--rust-root ..` or `RUST_ROOT=..` from the JavaScript release step.
- Only call `getRustRoot()` in `version-and-commit.mjs` when the release label is Rust.

Then re-run the release so npm gets 0.4.0.
title: JavaScript release after #38 failed: version-and-commit.mjs cannot find Cargo.toml from js/, npm still serves 0.3.0

Based on example here: https://github.com/deep-assistant/hive-mind/blob/787f13c0dc958b625f2494cb477e970c42e362ba/src/telegram-bot.mjs#L1-L120

We need a library, that allows to use https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation as https://github.com/link-foundation/lino-env and yargs as the same configuration preset.

Optionally we should allow to use dotenvx, but if it is used we should name it DEPRECATED and suggest to use Links Notation for ENV configuration instead.

We also should use https://github.com/link-foundation/test-anywhere for tests coverage and as template for complete CI/CD workflow.
title: Make first library prototype version
